# Remote Delivery Integrity Checklist: Remote Skill Delivery MVP

**Purpose**: Review whether requirements for remote-only delivery, progressive retrieval,
immutable provenance, canonical hashing, and client filesystem non-mutation are complete, clear,
consistent, and objectively assessable.
**Created**: 2026-08-11
**Feature**: [Remote Skill Delivery MVP](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context
and requirements. It evaluates the requirements themselves, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Do the requirements apply remote-response-only delivery to every MCP operation and
  every fresh, cached, retry, and failure path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the set of prohibited client-side destinations comprehensive, including client
  repositories, homes, skill and package directories, harnesses, temporary directories, caches,
  and other client-controlled locations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the payload boundaries for all three progressive stages fully specified: preview
  metadata from `search_skills`, instructions plus manifest from `load_skill`, and exactly one
  declared resource from `read_skill_resource`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009–FR-016]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are progressive-loading requirements defined for revisions with no resources, one
  resource, and multiple resources? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 - Does the provenance requirement define every required field and its normative shape,
  including source, exact revision, revision SHA-256, `trustAtPublication`,
  `currentAdvisoryStatus`, and the complete resource manifest? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 - Do immutability requirements cover instructions, resource content, manifest metadata,
  source identity, `trustAtPublication`, and other published revision metadata, while explicitly
  identifying `currentAdvisoryStatus` as separately derived? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 - Does the hashing requirement enumerate all included canonical inputs, all excluded
  provenance fields, the per-resource hash rule, and the versioning rule for future canonical
  formats? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012–FR-014, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is “consumed transiently” defined well enough to distinguish SkillWire's no-write
  obligation from storage decisions independently made by an MCP client after receiving a
  response? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is “must not install or write” explicit about indirect side effects such as package
  manager artifacts, lockfiles, generated files, dependency directories, and temporary content on
  the client? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005–FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the preview-content prohibition clear about whether all instruction excerpts are
  forbidden, rather than only a “complete” instruction document? [Clarity, Ambiguity,
  Spec §FR-009–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is an “exact immutable revision” defined with acceptable identifier rules and an
  explicit prohibition on aliases or floating labels such as `latest`, branches, and `HEAD`?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is “complete resource manifest” defined with required fields, deterministic path
  ordering, normalized byte lengths, media types, and per-resource hashes? [Clarity,
  Spec §FR-012, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are canonical serialization requirements normative about object shape, key and array
  ordering, encoding, serialization standard, hash-field exclusion, and lowercase hexadecimal
  output? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012–FR-014, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are text-normalization rules explicit for UTF-8 decoding, BOM removal, CRLF and CR
  conversion, Unicode normalization, NUL rejection, and preservation of trailing newlines?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 - Are the remote-only statements in FR-005, SC-005, the explicit exclusions, and
  Constitution Principle I consistent about both installation and any other client filesystem
  mutation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK016 - Do progressive-loading requirements consistently prevent search from returning skill
  content and `load_skill` from returning resource bodies while still providing everything needed
  to select and validate later resource reads? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009–FR-016]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is FR-013's prohibition on changed “content and manifest” consistent with the broader
  constitutional prohibition on silently changing published metadata? [Consistency, Conflict,
  Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK018 - Do the requirements consistently include source and `trustAtPublication` in the
  revision bundle hash while excluding the separately verified, derived `currentAdvisoryStatus`?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-012–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are cached-retrieval requirements identical to fresh-retrieval requirements for
  authentication, complete-bundle verification, provenance, auditability, and client non-mutation?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are future provider and optional adapter assumptions constrained to preserve the same
  MCP contracts, server-controlled sources, immutable revisions, progressive payloads, and
  no-client-install boundary? [Consistency, Assumption, Spec §FR-004–FR-005]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 - Does SC-005 define the monitored client filesystem scope, the before/after comparison
  boundary, and what counts as a creation or modification closely enough for objective assessment?
  [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 - Can SC-002 objectively distinguish a permitted capability summary from prohibited
  instruction content or resource content? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 - Does SC-003 require deterministic independent recomputation of both revision and
  resource hashes from normative fixtures or test vectors? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap,
  Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are measurable rejection criteria defined for revision-label reuse, revision hash
  mismatch, resource hash mismatch, incomplete manifests, and provenance substitution?
  [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-013–FR-014, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is SC-004's three-call journey scoped clearly when a skill has zero, one, or several
  progressively read resources? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 - Are primary requirements complete for search-only, search-to-load, and
  search-to-load-to-resource journeys without implying local materialization at any stage?
  [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007–FR-016]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are exception requirements defined independently for unknown revisions, undeclared
  resources, invalid paths, invalid text, oversized content, hash mismatches, and incomplete
  provenance, with no fallback to a different revision? [Coverage, Exception Flow,
  Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-017–FR-018]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are source-unavailable scenarios complete for a valid full cache, an incomplete cache,
  a stale or mismatched cache, and no cache? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK029 - Does the no-client-write guarantee explicitly cover normal responses, validation
  failures, authorization failures, retries, cache hits, cache failures, and partial progressive
  reads? [Coverage, Spec §SC-005, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for a source changing during bundle retrieval so that one
  response cannot combine files or metadata from different revision states? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 - Are canonicalization edge cases for empty text, empty manifests, duplicate manifest
  paths, equivalent path spellings, non-ASCII paths, and normalization-equivalent input documented?
  [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the sorting rule precise about byte or code-point ordering and duplicate handling
  for both manifest and resource entries? [Edge Case, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK033 - Do requirements specify whether raw or normalized byte counts govern instruction,
  resource, and complete-revision size limits, including content that crosses a limit during
  normalization? [Edge Case, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the revision identity behavior specified when raw files differ only in canonicalized
  details such as BOM or line endings? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-013–FR-014]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 - Is the assumption that SkillWire has no client filesystem capability stated as an
  architectural boundary while preserving a requirements-level prohibition against asking a client
  or adapter to install or materialize content? [Assumption, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are catalog-maintainer obligations documented for immutable source references,
  revision publication, canonical hash generation, trust decisions, and complete resource
  manifests? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Gap]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK037 - Is “published revision” tied to an explicit publication event and lifecycle so that
  maintainers cannot silently reinterpret an existing revision before or after deployment?
  [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is “verifiable provenance” separated clearly into published bundle integrity protected
  by the revision hash and current advisory state protected by the release-anchored advisory chain?
  [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are requirements explicit about whether a provenance-only change requires a new
  revision, a new revision hash, both, or rejection of the catalog entry? [Conflict, Gap,
  Spec §FR-013]
